summary: The ProgramCourseInfo handles the details of program courses within a placement request system. It consists of UI controls for displaying and editing course details, handling user permissions, and managing navigation through course-related actions.
purpose: Facilitates the management and display of program course information within a placement request context, allowing for CRUD operations, navigation, and user interaction.

workflows.name: Course Navigation and Editing
steps: On page load, setup program, course, placement type, cohort, and duration information using the Setup functions.
If QESEdit is enabled, user can edit fields; if not, fields are displayed as read-only.
Upon saving or canceling, actions are handled via cmdSave or cmdCancel events.

business_rules: Course link becomes a hyperlink if a profile exists or profile screen is editable.
Save/cancel panel only visible if screen is editable and specific controls are visible and enabled.
validations: Ensure QES course name is not blank during an edit.
Duration must be a positive decimal number.
conditions: Check if the page is loaded for the first time using ViewState["FirstLoad"].
Visibility of cmdToEnrollment depends on user's role and session variables.
system_behavior: SetupJavaScript function registers JavaScript variables for client-side interaction.
Page redirection is handled by the redirect function when changes are confirmed.
